verdict.rationale: Alerting is a fair question for an agent evaluation and observability platform, but the evidence never documents configurable alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops, nor any notification delivery to Slack, PagerDuty, or email. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a marketing line about real-time monitoring with autonomous fix and rollback, scorer pass thresholds that apply within evaluations, and Slack appearing only as a simulated data source.
